title: Source: Nvidia's board is not considering bringing Jensen Huang back as CEO and it is focused on a national security investigation into Huang (CNBC)
summary: CNBC: Source: Nvidia's board is not considering bringing Jensen Huang back as CEO and it is focused on a national security investigation into Huang — Nvidia's board of directors is not considering bringing back Jensen Huang as CEO, a person familiar with the matter told CNBC.
